description: Changes editable fields of one exact listing variation using HGRApi SaveProductChanges. Call only after the listing is exact and the user explicitly confirmed the action. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact change.

dispatchTimeDays.description: New dispatch handling time in days.

ignoreRules.description: Whether this listing ignores pricing rules.

monitorPrice.description: Whether HGR should monitor source price for this listing.

monitorPriceDecrease.description: Whether HGR should monitor source price decreases for this listing.

monitorStock.description: Whether HGR should monitor source stock for this listing.

paymentPolicy.description: New marketplace payment business policy id.

primeOnly.description: Whether this listing should use Prime-only source offers when applicable.

productId.description: Visible marketplace Product Id / primary id. Prefer this when the user provides a Product Id.

returnPolicy.description: New marketplace return business policy id.

shippingPolicy.description: New marketplace shipping business policy id.

variationProductId.description: Visible variation Product Id / primary id when the listing has multiple variations.

name: hgr_update_listing
title: Update Listing
